title: Generosity
definition: Generosity is the cheerful, sacrificial sharing of what God has entrusted for the good of others and the glory of Christ.
summary: Grace makes believers open-handed rather than self-protective.
christFocus: Jesus Christ became poor for our sake, and His grace teaches His people to give freely.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Generosity describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is grace makes believers open-handed rather than self-protective.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Generosity teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let generosity shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
